items.name: types
items.title: Types
items.description: Core TypeScript type definitions for the design canvas — element types, camera, tools, panels, hit testing, and interaction state.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: math
items.title: Math
items.description: Geometry helpers — rotate point, bounds checking, ellipse hit test, screen/world coordinate conversion, normalize bounds, distance, and clamping.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: id
items.title: ID
items.description: ID generation utility using crypto.randomUUID.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: color
items.title: Color
items.description: OKLCh color parsing and manipulation utilities — parse, serialize, and adjust lightness.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: document-store
items.title: Document Store
items.description: Zustand store for canvas document state — elements, camera, selection, and undo/redo history with colocated actions.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: tool-store
items.title: Tool Store
items.description: Zustand store for active tool state with temporary tool support (e.g. hold Space for hand tool).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: panel-store
items.title: Panel Store
items.description: Zustand store for panel visibility — left panel, right panel, and open/collapse state.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: element-factory
items.title: Element Factory
items.description: Factory functions for creating design elements — rectangle, ellipse, text, line, and frame with sensible defaults.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: renderer
items.title: Renderer
items.description: Pure Canvas 2D rendering functions — grid, elements (rectangle, ellipse, text, line, frame), selection boxes, resize handles, creation preview, and marquee.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: hit-test
items.title: Hit Test
items.description: Pure geometry functions for point-in-element testing, element-at-point lookup, marquee selection, and resize handle detection.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-drag
items.title: useCanvasDrag
items.description: Hook for managing drag state machine — tracks drag type (create, move, resize, marquee, pan), start/current positions, and element snapshots.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-transform
items.title: useCanvasTransform
items.description: Hook for screen/world coordinate conversion, pan, zoom-to-point, zoom in/out, and reset zoom.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-hit-test
items.title: useHitTest
items.description: Hook wrapping hit-test functions with canvas state — get element or resize handle at screen point.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-renderer
items.title: useCanvasRenderer
items.description: Hook for the requestAnimationFrame render loop — dirty-flag optimization, DPR-aware canvas sizing, and full render pipeline (grid, elements, selection UI, creation preview, marquee).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-canvas-interaction
items.title: useCanvasInteraction
items.description: Hook for pointer event handling — state machine for idle, panning, creating, moving, resizing, and marquee selecting. Handles element creation, selection, and drag operations.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: useKeyboardShortcuts
items.description: Hook for global keyboard shortcuts — tool switching (V/R/O/T/F), delete, undo/redo, select all, duplicate, zoom, and temporary hand tool (Space hold).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: design-canvas
items.title: Design Canvas
items.description: The main canvas component — renders a full-size HTML5 Canvas element with cursor management, pointer events, and keyboard shortcuts wired up.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Floating toolbar with toggle groups, toggle buttons with tooltips, separators, and dropdown menus for tool variant selection. Built directly on Radix primitives.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: Side panel container with position (left/right), variant (tool/default), border, and scroll area. Used for layers, properties, and other side panels.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: pane
items.title: Pane
items.description: Content section within a panel — Pane wrapper with PaneHeader, PaneLabel, and PaneAction for composing property editors.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: action
items.title: Action
items.description: Form field row layout — Action container with ActionLabel and ActionControls for consistent label + control rows in property panes.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider component built directly on Radix Slider primitive with design tool styling.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: Container component for creative surfaces — provides consistent mount point with canvas background, optional overlay controls, and dot grid background.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: easing
items.title: Easing
items.description: Cubic bezier easing utilities — presets, evaluation via Newton's method, CSS cubic-bezier() parsing and serialisation.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: animation-store
items.title: Animation Store
items.description: Zustand store for animation playback — duration, current time, play/pause, zoom level, and keyframe selection.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Compound timeline component with ruler, playhead, tracks, keyframe diamonds, and transport controls for animation and sequencing tools.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

meta.example: <Timeline><TimelineTransport /><TimelineRuler duration={5} zoomLevel={100} /><TimelineTrack label="opacity"><TimelineKeyframe time={0} duration={5} zoomLevel={100} /><TimelineKeyframe time={2.5} duration={5} zoomLevel={100} /></TimelineTrack></Timeline>

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Numeric input with drag-to-scrub on the label, arrow key stepping, shift for larger increments, and optional suffix. Designed for property editors.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: history-controls
items.title: History Controls
items.description: Undo and redo buttons that read from the document store. Position anywhere — inside a toolbar, panel header, or floating independently.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: Responsive thumbnail grid with selection state, hover overlays, and action buttons. Used for image histories, asset browsers, and media galleries.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: colour-picker
items.title: Colour Picker
items.description: Colour picker with hex input and swatch preview, powered by react-colorful in a Radix Popover. Used in material editors, fill/stroke controls, and chart styling.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: easing-curve-editor
items.title: Easing Curve Editor
items.description: Interactive cubic bezier curve editor with draggable control points and preset buttons. Used for keyframe easing in animation tools.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

meta.example: <EasingCurveEditor value={{ x1: 0.42, y1: 0, x2: 0.58, y2: 1 }} onChange={setEasing} />

items.name: use-selection
items.title: useSelection
items.description: Multi-select hook with cmd-click toggle and shift-click range selection.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-drag-reorder
items.title: useDragReorder
items.description: Pointer-based list reordering with visual feedback and pointer capture.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-clipboard
items.title: useClipboard
items.description: Copy, cut, and paste with keyboard shortcuts and system clipboard integration.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-viewport
items.title: useViewport
items.description: Pan and zoom state management for canvas surfaces — coordinate transforms, pinch-zoom, and zoom-to-fit.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: use-undoable
items.title: useUndoable
items.description: Lightweight undo/redo stack using refs for performance — pushSnapshot, undo, redo.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: Keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Declarative keyboard shortcut registration and formatting — replaces switch statements with a structured map.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: snap
items.title: Snap
items.description: Grid snapping and smart edge snapping utilities — snapToGrid, snapToGuides, guidesFromBounds.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: bounding-box
items.title: Bounding box
items.description: Bounding box computation — union, intersection, containment, expansion, and point-in-bounds testing.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: alignment-controls
items.title: Alignment Controls
items.description: Horizontal and vertical alignment and distribution buttons for positioning selected elements on the canvas.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status indicator with variant support. Used for element type labels, node badges, and status indicators.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Navigation breadcrumb trail for showing document or frame hierarchy. Supports click-to-navigate.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: collapsible-pane
items.title: Collapsible Pane
items.description: Expandable pane section with animated open/close and chevron indicator. Wraps PaneHeader and PaneContent.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Searchable command launcher overlay triggered by keyboard shortcut. Groups commands with icons and shortcut hints.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click context menu with items, separators, sub-menus, and keyboard shortcut display.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: document-tabs
items.title: Document Tabs
items.description: Tab bar for switching between open documents or canvases. Supports close button and active state.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Placeholder component for empty panels, lists, or surfaces. Displays a title, description, and optional icon or action.

meta.example: <EmptyState title="No layers" description="Draw something to get started" />

items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: layer-list
items.title: Layer List
items.description: Sortable layer panel with visibility and lock toggles, icons, and context menu support. Compound component pattern.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: node
items.title: Node
items.description: Card-based node for visual programming editors with typed input/output ports, preview area, dividers, and badges. Seven port types with CSS variable colours.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: number-slider
items.title: Number Slider
items.description: Combined number input and slider in a single row. Pairs NumberInput with Slider for properties like opacity or font size.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating content panel anchored to a trigger element. Used for colour pickers, mini inspectors, and inline editors.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Horizontal progress indicator with animated fill. Used for generation progress, file uploads, and loading states.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: resizer
items.title: Resizer
items.description: Draggable resize handle for creating split regions between panels or panes. Vertical and horizontal orientations.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown select input with label, built on Radix Select. Used for blend modes, font families, and enumerated properties.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: shortcut-overlay
items.title: Shortcut Overlay
items.description: Full-screen overlay displaying grouped keyboard shortcuts. Triggered by a help shortcut (typically ?).
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: status-bar
items.title: Status Bar
items.description: Bottom bar showing tool state, selection count, zoom level, and other status indicators. Compound component with sections and items.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: swatch-palette
items.title: Swatch Palette
items.description: Grid of colour swatches for quick colour selection. Supports custom palettes and active swatch indicator.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: text-area
items.title: Text Area
items.description: Multi-line text input with label and design tool styling. Used for prompts, descriptions, and code fields.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Notification toast with undo support, powered by Sonner. Used for action confirmations, errors, and undo-able deletions.

meta.example: toast("Element deleted", { action: { label: "Undo", onClick: undo } })

items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Boolean toggle switch input with label and design tool styling. Built on Radix Toggle.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Grouped set of toggles for single or multi-select choices. Built on Radix ToggleGroup.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: tree-list
items.title: Tree List
items.description: Hierarchical tree view with expand/collapse, selection, and drag-to-reorder. Used for scene graphs and nested layer structures.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>

items.name: zoom-controls
items.title: Zoom Controls
items.description: Zoom in, zoom out, and reset buttons with percentage display. Typically placed in the status bar or toolbar.
items.author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>
